sections.heading: Explore the Depths of Your Psyche. Align with the Cycles of Your Soul.
sections.subtitle: Jungian Analysis & Psychological Astrology with Meltem Ersoy, Toronto.

sections.heading: You sense there is more to your story.

children.text: You've done the work—the reading, the reflecting, the wondering. Yet something still feels unfinished. Patterns repeat. Dreams linger. A deeper language is trying to speak.
This is the space where that language finds a voice.
Meltem Ersoy is a Jungian Analyst and Registered Psychotherapist in Toronto—and a practicing Psychological Astrologer with over twenty years of experience.
She bridges the wisdom of depth psychology with the symbolic language of the cosmos, creating a therapeutic space where psyche and soul can speak freely.

services.title: Jungian Psychotherapy
services.description: In-depth talk therapy exploring unconscious patterns, dreams, and symbols.

services.title: Psychological Astrology
services.description: Using the birth chart as a map of the psyche to explore archetypal patterns and life cycles.

services.title: Integrated Sessions
services.description: Combining both modalities for a holistic therapeutic journey.

sections.heading: Why Jungian Analysis?
sections.body: Jungian analysis goes beyond symptom management. It is a journey into the depths of the psyche—a conversation with the unconscious, conducted through dreams, symbols, and the timeless language of myth.

sections.heading: Why Psychological Astrology?
sections.body: The birth chart is not a prediction. It is a map—a reflection of archetypal patterns that shape our lives. In psychological astrology, we explore these patterns not as fate, but as material for conscious engagement and transformation.

steps.title: Free Consultation
steps.description: A 30-minute conversation to explore your needs and see if we're a fit.

steps.title: Begin the Work
steps.description: Sessions that blend Jungian analysis and/or astrological insight, online or in-person.

steps.title: Transformation
steps.description: Over time, patterns shift. Understanding deepens. You become more fully yourself.

items.question: What is psychological astrology?
items.answer: It is the use of astrological symbolism as a tool for self-understanding and personal development—not prediction, but reflection.

items.question: Do I need to believe in astrology to work with you?
items.answer: Not at all. Many clients come with curiosity, not belief. The work is grounded in psychology, not faith.

items.question: How much does a session cost?
items.answer: Individual sessions are $100. The initial 30-minute consultation is free.

items.question: Do you offer online sessions?
items.answer: Yes, I offer both in-person sessions in Toronto and online sessions via secure video call.
